events.title: Thank You for 100 000 Wishlists!
events.summary: Greetings Commanders!It has been almost 2 weeks since the Demo went live, and it's been great to see so many players both returning from the playtest and checking out Main Sequence for the first time. Thanks to your support, Main Sequence now has more than 100 000 wishlists!It has been great to see lots of new feedback for the Demo. Because Main Sequence combines many genres, as the game reaches new players there are many different expectations for what kind of game Main Sequence is and can be.

events.title: Demo Available Now!
events.summary: Greeting Commanders! Today is a big step forward for Main Sequence. After many months of gathering feedback from the playtest, the Demo is finally ready and available now!The demo features many improvements and additions, including a complete visual overhaul of the ship, stations, and factories. There are new tutorials to help guide you through the early game, and some longterm objectives to strive for.
